# Steven Fazzio

> Personal site and blog of Steven Fazzio, a data scientist who makes interactive
> maps of large text collections (embeddings, clustering, interactive datamaps).
> The blog post is the canonical write-up for every project; the interactive
> artifacts themselves are served at subpaths of this domain (one project per
> subpath, e.g. https://stevenfazzio.com/semantic-github-map/).

## Pages

- [Posts](https://stevenfazzio.com/posts/): project write-ups, explainers, and essays
- [Projects](https://stevenfazzio.com/projects/): index of all interactive projects
- [About](https://stevenfazzio.com/about/): who Steven is, what he does, contact
- [RSS](https://stevenfazzio.com/rss.xml): full-text feed of all posts

## Contact

- Email: steven@stevenfazzio.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/stevenfazzio
